bundles.evidenceText: we are all currently you know submitting to a certain idea of what we're going to do.
bundles.rationale: The excerpt asserts that people collectively submit to a shared idea about what they will do. That proposition supports the subsidiary bridge by presenting collective purpose and constraint as human coordination and social practice. The central bridge is the nearest competitor, but it is broader: the excerpt does not generally claim that patterns and values are mind-grounded abstractions or establish the complete motion-level conclusion.

bundles.evidenceText: because I saw what it what it meant or what it brought downstream, what it the portrait of the world that it was showing me.
bundles.rationale: The excerpt asserts that resurrection was credible because of its experienced meaning, downstream consequences, and portrait of the world rather than isolated historical attestation. This directly supports the subsidiary symbolic-meaning bridge. The central bridge is excluded because the passage does not assert that purposive unities point upward to Logos, and it does not supply the complete motion-level conclusion.
